seoTitle: Cincinnati CPS Calendar 2025–26: Dates, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Cincinnati Public Schools starts Aug. 20, 2025 and ends May 28, 2026. See CPS breaks, no-student days, quarter dates, official PDF, and ICS download.
heroSummary: Cincinnati Public Schools students start Wednesday, August 20, 2025 and finish Thursday, May 28, 2026. The official 12-month calendar lists 171 student days and 191 teacher days. Students are out for Thanksgiving week November 24–28, Winter Recess December 22–January 2, and Spring Break March 23–27.
heroSourceLine: 2025–26 student dates · Verified against the official Cincinnati CPS 12-month calendar
calendarNotes: CPS students begin August 20 and finish May 28. The PDF lists 171 student days and 191 teacher days, with quarter totals of 40, 38, 45, and 48 instructional days. September 22, October 2, January 5, and March 2 are staff work or professional-development days with no students. Thanksgiving week closes schools November 24–28, including a Teacher Conference Exchange Day on November 26. Winter Recess closes schools December 22–January 2, followed by a district professional-development day January 5; students return January 6. February 9 is a school-only break and Teacher Conference Exchange Day, not part of a longer February recess. The PDF identifies Summer School separately for June 1–30 and continues through July for district operating holidays, so those dates do not extend the regular student year.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Cincinnati Public Schools start in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for students is Wednesday, August 20, 2025. Teacher work, professional-development, and building meeting days run August 13–19 before students begin.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cincinnati CPS Thanksgiving Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are out November 24–28, 2025. November 26 is also a Teacher Conference Exchange Day; the central office closes November 27–28.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cincinnati CPS Winter Recess in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess runs December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026. January 5 is a no-student professional-development day, and schools reopen January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cincinnati CPS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 23 through Friday, March 27, 2026. Schools reopen Monday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day for Cincinnati CPS students in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day and end of Quarter 4 is Thursday, May 28, 2026. May 29 is the final teacher classroom workday.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are on the Cincinnati CPS 2025–26 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists 171 student days and 191 teacher days. Its four quarters contain 40, 38, 45, and 48 instructional days.
